b2-16-01.title: Communicative Challenge: A Careless Slip
b2-16-01.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks why you paid a fine. You did not look at the date.
b2-16-01.prompt: Tell Meg why you paid the fine and what you would have done.
cues: Say what you would have done differently
Say that you paid the fine
b2-16-01.target: Si hubiera mirado la fecha, no habría pagado la multa.
b2-16-01.english: If I had looked at the date, I would not have paid the fine.
b2-16-01.canDo: I can form the pluperfect subjunctive with hubiera or hubiese and a past participle.

b2-16-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Too Late for Tickets
b2-16-02.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks why you look sad. The concert tickets sold out, and you did not buy them in time.
b2-16-02.prompt: Tell Carlos what you wish you had done.
cues: Say that you wish you had bought the tickets
Say when you should have bought them
b2-16-02.target: Ojalá hubiera comprado los boletos a tiempo.
b2-16-02.english: I wish I had bought the tickets in time.
b2-16-02.canDo: I can say a wish about the past with ojalá + hubiera or hubiese + participle.

b2-16-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Leaving Earlier
b2-16-03.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos says he missed the train because he left home late. Tell him that, without si, he would have arrived on time if he had left earlier.
b2-16-03.prompt: Tell Carlos what would have happened if he had left earlier.
cues: Say what he should have done earlier
b2-16-03.target: De haber salido antes, habrías llegado a tiempo.
b2-16-03.english: Had you left earlier, you would have arrived on time.
b2-16-03.canDo: I can say an unreal past condition with si hubiera, de haber or hubiera at the start.

b2-16-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Pity You Missed It
b2-16-04.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos did not come to a party yesterday. Tell him that it surprised you and that it was a pity.
b2-16-04.prompt: Tell Carlos how you felt about his not coming.
cues: Say that it surprised you that he had not come
Say that it was a pity
b2-16-04.target: Me sorprendió que no hubieras venido a la fiesta; fue una lástima.
b2-16-04.english: It surprised me that you had not come to the party; it was a pity.
b2-16-04.canDo: I can judge the past with habría sido mejor que + hubiera + participle.

b2-16-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Old Edition
b2-16-05.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos finds hubiese in an old edition of a book and asks if it is the same as hubiera.
b2-16-05.prompt: Tell Carlos whether the two forms are the same, and which one you would say.
cues: Say that the two forms are the same
Say which one you would say when you speak
b2-16-05.target: Sí, es lo mismo; en la conversación yo diría hubiera.
b2-16-05.english: Yes, it is the same; in conversation I would say "hubiera".
b2-16-05.canDo: I can recognise hubiese + participle as the same as hubiera + participle.

b2-16-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Nobody Told Me
b2-16-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks why you did not go to the party. Nobody had told you about it.
b2-16-consolidation.prompt: Tell Carlos why you did not go.
cues: Say what you would have done if they had told you
b2-16-consolidation.target: Si me hubieran avisado, habría ido a la fiesta.
b2-16-consolidation.english: If they had told me, I would have gone to the party.
b2-16-consolidation.canDo: I can use the pluperfect subjunctive in conditions, wishes and judgments about the past.
